help.description: At 10 Academy, we’re dedicated to getting you ready, in 6 months, for a global-level AI career with our comprehensive and up-to-date curriculum, bridging the gaps between what you already know and what employers require.
help.summary: Set up a call now to learn more, or apply!

detail.title: We Don’t Teach You, We Train You
detail.description: Our program offers real-world projects sourced from industry partners.  Within 3 months, you will have experience developing AI chatbots, building and fine-tuning models for African languages, and building data analytics tools. These projects give you demonstrable hands-on experience in areas of relevance to industry and experience in end-to-end projects.

detail.title: Master the Skills That Matter
detail.description: By completing our program, you’ll gain expertise in key areas such as Generative AI, Machine Learning Engineering, and Data Engineering. You’ll also master skills in AI/ML model development, SQL and Python programming, and software development frameworks.

detail.title: Launch Your Career with Confidence
detail.description: We provide personalized career guidance, real-time support, and a community-rich learning environment to boost your global job readiness. You’ll develop essential competencies in professionalism, cross-cultural communication, and remote teamwork, along with advanced technical skills.

next_step.description: By joining 10 Academy, you’ll get the support needed to transition into a global-level AI and tech career in the competitive job market.
next_step.summary: Apply now to start your journey towards becoming an industry-ready AI professional!
